pilot_mode: DESTRUCTIVE-WITH-RESET (edits applied inside worktree, will be wiped)

tsc_result.mid_edit_fix: AuthCtx.db widened to any; deliberate, documented (would otherwise require importing DataModel from _generated/ which creates a circular dep).

top_critical_findings.issue: adminProcessRefund checked identity only, NOT role.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any Clerk-authenticated client could refund any payment by id.

top_critical_findings.issue: createOrder was a public mutation with zero auth.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any caller could insert arbitrary orders (price, line items, payment binding).
top_critical_findings.fix_applied: Requires serviceKey arg validated by assertServiceKey. migrateOrder / deleteOrder → internalMutation.

top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any authed client could burn another instructor's session inventory.
top_critical_findings.fix_applied: requireAdminUser. 11 mutations in this file gained the same gate; migrateInstructor → internalMutation.

top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any authed client could grant another instructor arbitrary session inventory.

top_critical_findings.issue: useSession public mutation accepting any id, decremented any pack by 1.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any signed-in caller could deplete another student's session pack.

top_critical_findings.issue: upsertUserIdentity public mutation letting any caller bind a Discord providerUserId to any Clerk userId/email.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Account-linking abuse; attacker could claim / take over another user's Discord identity.

top_critical_findings.issue: markReviewed verified sub.instructorId === args.instructorId (client-supplied) but NOT that the caller was actually that instructor.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any caller could mark any submission reviewed by passing an arbitrary instructorId value.
top_critical_findings.fix_applied: Also verifies instructor.userId === identity.subject OR admin; reviewedByUserId derived from identity.subject rather than from a client-supplied args.instructorId.

top_critical_findings.issue: updateUploadStarted / completeUpload had NO auth check.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any caller could mark another user's upload as completed / started; affects video-editor storage flows.
top_critical_findings.fix_applied: Resolve caller via getAuthenticatedUser; upload.uploadedById === caller.userId/clerkId OR caller.role ∈ {admin, video_editor}. migrateInstructorUpload → internalMutation.

top_critical_findings.issue: updateSession / completeSession had no auth — any caller could patch any session's fields.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Video room URL takeover, instructor/student swapping, recording-URL redirection.
top_critical_findings.fix_applied: requireIdentity + session.studentId === identity.subject OR instructor.userId === identity.subject. deleteSession → internalMutation.

top_critical_findings.issue: linkWorkspaceToSessionPack only guard was confirmSeed:true literal.
top_critical_findings.why_exploitable: Any Convex client that knew the function name could mint a seat reservation + link it to a workspace.

all_patched_mutations: convex/instructors.ts: decrementInventory / incrementInventory / upsertInstructorTestimonial / upsertStudentResult / uploadInstructorProfileImage / uploadInstructorPortfolio / uploadStudentResultImage / updateInstructorProfileImage / updateInstructorPortfolio / backfillInstructorUserId / createInstructor (requireAdminUser)
judgment_calls: Many migrate*/cron conversions → internalMutation break scripts/migrate-to-convex/*.ts and apps/web Inngest callers. Cleanest follow-up: service-key HTTP endpoint and forward from there.
payments.ts internalisation breaks apps/web/inngest/functions/payments.ts public-namespace calls; needs service-key HTTP path.
orders.ts:createOrder now requires serviceKey — checkout routes that don't already provide one break at deploy time as 401.
seatReservations/sessionPacks admin/orSupport gates break Inngest payment flow; move to service-key HTTP endpoints.
seed.ts:internal change breaks scripts/seed-test-workspaces.ts; needs internal-via-service-key refactor.
All breakages surface as 401/403, not data corruption.
what_we_didnt_do: no commits, no pushes, no PRs
did not modify _generated/, *.d.ts, *.test.ts, or anything outside convex/
did not touch convex/admin.ts (isAdminUser reused by requireAdminUser)
did not change Clerk configuration or env vars (Clerk Changes Policy)
did not widen scope beyond audit target — false-positive hits left intact
